channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Buggos 2
item.description: You are the Buggo Hivemind. In this low-micro swarm RTS you place spawners, set attack pins and send up to 5,000 bugs into the dirty Humans' walls and turrets. Evolve your swarm across a 45-mission campaign, then take it into Survival, Workshop maps or 4-player online battles.

item.title: Craftlings
item.description: Build a bustling settlement in a 2D logistics puzzle. Guide tiny workers through the routes you create, connect production chains, and solve handcrafted missions. Charming to watch, rewarding to figure out.

item.title: Airborne Kingdom
item.description: The sky city builder awaits. Create your own flying kingdom and lead it on a quest across an expansive world. Explore the varied landscape, build up a floating metropolis, aid struggling people below, uncover lost secrets and, ultimately, bring back the Airborne Kingdom legend.

item.title: Styx: Master of Shadows
item.description: Styx: Master of Shadows is an infiltration game with RPG elements taking place in a dark fantasy universe, where you sneak, steal and assassinate your way through as Styx, a Goblin two-centuries of age.

item.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Alberta Hunting Preserve
item.description: It’s bitterly cold, but the Albertan wilderness is teeming with life. Discover and hunt 19 local species, tackle 13 exclusive missions, and explore this stunning snowy preserve.

item.title: Hubble Bubble
item.description: Co-op hookah shop sim for 1 to 4 friends. Run Ghalyan's Hookah Lounge on a space station: pack the bowl, light the coals, serve the aliens and act normal. Nothing on this station is normal.

item.title: Master of Command - The Lion & Eagle
item.description: The Lion & Eagle DLC adds two new playable nations to Master of Command: Sweden and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. Command new armies, doctrines, reforms, units, regions, encounters, music, officer traits, items, and flag emblems as you march under the Swedish lion or the Commonwealth eagle.

item.title: Popcorn & Premieren - Ausgehviertel
item.description: Expand your cinema with a leisure district featuring a pizzeria, beach club, restaurant, ice cream café, arcade, bowling, mini golf, stage and event hall. Upgrade businesses, manage your investment and collect parking fees, with real financial risks as well as opportunities.

item.title: Squad Weapon Skins - Recon Team Pack
item.description: This pack contains 5 woodland weapon skins for the USMC faction.
